items.title: Sumner Labat Interview, 1962-11-11
items.q: And then I had Kid Ricard, Ricard Alexis. He was tough and easy.

ctx.x: My mother's great. I didn't know they played together. I didn't know they played together. I don't know, I may be wrong, but I don't think those two ever played together. Chris Kelly? Chris Kelly was selling his name? Well I didn't know him, that's what I said. Oh, Guy Kelly you might be thinking of. Who? Guy Kelly. That's what he was talking about. In fact, I didn't think Chris would play with Sonny Sommers. I didn't think it was two, I don't know, I may be wrong, but I don't think those two ever played…

Oh, they had good trumpet players. They joined because, you know, they'd come to the band here. Oh, yeah. He was first class, good reading and everything. And then I had Kid Ricard, Ricard Alexis. He was tough and easy. And then I had, I had pretty good, what the sugar. Kai ever played with you?
